defect: v9 tries the stored program's refit at a new cutoff once under a 45 s statement limit and drops the program on timeout; in v9 runs 1-3 this happened in 5 of 36 rel-trial and 2 of 36 rel-stack reuse sessions (one rel-trial fallback left a constant-only program that the next cutoff inherited)
how_found: session execution records (target_detail.why = statement timeout), read after the v9 test scores were known; the change is decided from execution failures, not from scores
change: on a statement timeout the refit is retried once under the standard 600 s statement limit (FEATURE_SQL_TIMEOUT_S); other errors are not retried; the first attempt keeps the 45 s limit; all attempts stay charged to the session
unchanged: everything else in v9: cold start, reuse call/tool caps, additions, audits, learner, data, cutoffs, model service, reasoning effort, Rust backend binary
runs: three runs per database from empty memory, identical inputs; --run only names the database and output folder
concurrency: at most four cells at once
paper_row: Table III MAVRA row = mean over the three v10 runs; every run reported; v9's three runs stay in this directory and the README
no_selection: all three v10 runs are reported whatever their scores; no further method change after these runs
budget_guard: budget-watch cap 20 CNY over the v10 cells
